boundary_case_rule: one ranked boundary case is fractionally assigned so each HWGT budget is exact
delay_clause_not_modeled: tier_of applies the 7 USC 2013(a)(2) shares immediately; the OBBBA delayed-implementation provision for the highest-error states (the 13.33 percent boundary the movement memo computes as rate x 1.5 >= 20) is not modeled, so near-term dollar exposure for states above it is overstated
interpretation: accounting construction: what happens to the measured rate if counted error dollars in this group fall by X, however achieved

issuance_source.caveat: whether the cost column includes disaster-supplement dollars is unverified; the file title confirms only P-EBT/other issuance is excluded
issuance_source.semantics: Per-state 'Cost' column = SNAP benefit dollars issued, reported monthly for the 12 federal fiscal-year months Oct 2023 through Sep 2024, organized in FNS region sheets (NERO/MARO/SERO/MWRO/SWRO/MPRO/WRO). Each state's 'Total' row for Cost is the ANNUAL SUM of the 12 monthly values (verified exactly for every jurisdiction; the participation columns' Total row is by contrast a monthly average). Values are dollars, not thousands. Title states P-EBT/Other issuance is excluded. The sum equals the 'Total Benefits' line (not 'Total Costs', which adds admin) of the FNS National Level Annual Summary, confirming the column is benefit issuance.

runtime: measured externally and reported in INTERVENTIONS_REPORT.md to keep regeneration byte-identical
self_employment_definition: any available SLFEMP1-18 > 0 or FSSLFEMP > 0, after CASE == 1 and valid-state filtering shared with train_error_model.load_year
sustained_intervention_assumption: the single-measurement rate delta is subtracted from the anchored FY2028-30 path in every horizon year because the procedure persists
threshold_convention: single-measurement deltas price FY2024 counted errors at the official nominal threshold; the persistence anchor path derives from the fixed-real-threshold panel; both are location-anchored on FY2025 official rates
